title: 3D Finish and 3D Pocket refuse the sample STEP laid flat: two solids sharing a face slice as "non-manifold contact", reported as invalid machining parameters

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
## What happens

`testdata/models/sample_ap214.step` laid flat (rotated -90° about X) cannot be machined by any 3D operation. 3D Finish and 3D Pocket are both refused before any toolpath is planned:

```
generate: S1 - could not generate the toolpath: S1: invalid machining parameters: chords meet 3+ ways at z = 1.8359437500001423: non-manifold contact
generate: R1 - could not generate the toolpath: R1: invalid machining parameters: chords meet 3+ ways at z = 1.8359437500001423: non-manifold contact
```

The model is a valid STEP file. The message blames "machining parameters", but no parameter is at fault, and nothing tells the user what is wrong with the model or what to change.

## Reproduction (main 38699549, `camcraft-cli mcp`)

`slice.rs`, `slice_weld.rs`, `crates/app/src/operation/` and `crates/motion/src/machining3d/` are unchanged from there to 3f6ecb4a.

```json
[["import_model", {"path": "testdata/models/sample_ap214.step"}],
 ["move_model", {"name": "sample_ap214", "position": [0, -26.7192, 1.5875], "rotation": [-0.7071067811865476, 0, 0, 0.7071067811865476]}],
 ["set_stock", {"box": {"dx": 70, "dy": 124, "dz": 8}}],
 ["add_tool", {"catalog": "BN-0600"}],
 ["add_tool", {"catalog": "EM-0600-4FL"}],
 ["add_operation", {"kind": "finish3d", "tool": "BN-0600", "name": "S1", "source": "sample_ap214"}],
 ["add_operation", {"kind": "pocket3d", "tool": "EM-0600-4FL", "name": "R1", "source": "sample_ap214"}],
 ["add_operation", {"kind": "contour", "tool": "EM-0600-4FL", "name": "C1", "source": "sample_ap214"}],
 ["add_operation", {"kind": "pocket", "tool": "EM-0600-4FL", "name": "P1", "source": "sample_ap214"}],
 ["generate", {"name": "S1"}], ["generate", {"name": "R1"}],
 ["generate", {"name": "C1"}], ["generate", {"name": "P1"}]]
```

S1 and R1 are refused as quoted above. The Parallel and Waterline patterns of 3D Finish give the same refusal.

## Neighbour cases that work

- The same model in the same placement, with 2D Contour C1 and 2D Pocket P1: both generate (`status: ok`, 52 and 748 moves).
- A throwaway test called `geometry::slice::slice` on `model::world_facets` of the laid-flat model, every 0.05 mm in Z. The model is three solids (`MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP` 'Part 1' to 'Part 3'). It was split into bodies by shared vertices:

| Facets sliced | Z span (mm) | Planes refused |
|---|---|---|
| all three solids | 0 .. 6.5278 | 32 of 129 (z 1.60 .. 3.15) |
| body 0 alone (1758 facets) | 0 .. 3.1750 | 0 of 62 |
| body 1 alone (968 facets) | 1.5875 .. 4.7625 | 0 of 62 |
| body 2 alone (452 facets) | 0.1778 .. 6.5278 | 0 of 126 |
| bodies 0 + 1 | 0 .. 4.7625 | 32 of 94 (z 1.60 .. 3.15) |
| bodies 0 + 2 | 0 .. 6.5278 | 0 of 129 |
| bodies 1 + 2 | 0.1778 .. 6.5278 | 0 of 126 |
| all three, as imported (not rotated) | -32.357 .. 85.851 | 0 of 2363 |

The refused band is exactly where bodies 0 and 1 overlap in Z: 1.5875 .. 3.175.

## Root cause (confirmed)

`slice()` in `crates/geometry/src/geometry/slice.rs` (step 2, lines 158-180) requires every chord end to be shared by exactly two chords. Bodies 0 and 1 share a cylindrical face of radius 17.5146 mm about the model's XY origin (0, -26.7192), and both solids carry identical tessellation vertices on it. Laid flat, that face stands vertical. Every plane through the two bodies' common height therefore cuts both section outlines through the same points. At z = 2.0 there are 93 such points, all at r = 17.5146, each the end of four chords (two from each body). The exact weld returns `SliceError::NonManifold` there.

That refusal comes before step 4 (`Region::from_slices`), whose comment reads "the non-zero fuse unites shells". As imported, the cylinder's axis is horizontal, and every plane slices (last row of the table).

`from_slice` in `crates/app/src/operation/material.rs:250` and `crates/motion/src/machining3d/rest.rs:23` then maps the refusal to `GenError::Invalid`. That error prints as "invalid machining parameters: …".

### Related

M13.11 already reads a plane as the union of touching bodies, but only for a selection across several models:

- `Material.bodies` (`crates/app/src/operation/material.rs`) is filled only in `material_of`'s `SrcRef::Selection` arm.
- `verify::verify_bodies` and `machining2d::contour_on_bodies` read it.

A single model holding several solids arrives as `SrcRef::Entity`, so `bodies` stays empty. `material::section()` then slices its facets plainly.

## Expected

Solids of one model that touch along a face slice as their union; each solid slices on its own at every one of those planes. If a section really cannot be built, the refusal names the model and says its solids touch at that height, instead of blaming machining parameters.

## Suggested labels

Outside contributors can't set labels, so these are suggestions:

- `P3`: a legal 3D job on a shipped sample model is refused, with a misleading message.
- `effort:high`: slicer behaviour; the geometry safety floor.
- `area:3d`
- `source:agent`
